message.content:
Based on my review of the full-page screenshot for Emrais Engineering Services Limited, here is the detailed assessment:

## 1) Hero Section Background
**No, it is not showing correctly.** The hero section is displaying as a **solid light gray/white background** instead of the intended maroon/red color. This appears to be a critical styling issue where either:
- The CSS background-color property failed to load
- An overlay opacity issue is washing out the color
- The background image (if any) isn't rendering, leaving only a gray fallback

The white text ("Engineering Excellence, Transforming Concepts Into Reality") has very poor contrast against this light background, making it difficult to read.

## 2) Logo Visibility
**Yes, partially:**
- **Header:** The logo (circular red emblem with "EMRAIS" text) **is visible** in the top-left corner of the navigation bar.
- **Footer:** The logo **is also visible** in the bottom-left area of the black footer section.

Both instances appear to be rendering correctly with proper alignment.

## 3) Section Rendering Status
All sections are present and structurally intact:

| Section | Status | Notes |
|---------|--------|-------|
| **About** | ✅ Rendered | "Who We Are," Mission/Vision cards, Core Values grid all display properly |
| **Services** | ✅ Rendered | 8 service cards (Structural, Hydraulic, Environmental, etc.) with icons and bullet points visible |
| **Projects** | ✅ Rendered | 3 project cards (Life Camp, New Millennium City, Apo 3) with contract values and years |
| **Equipment** | ✅ Rendered | Grid of equipment items (Concrete Mixers, Cars, Tippers, Trucks, etc.) with counts |
| **Compliance** | ✅ Rendered | Certification/license grid (RC, TIN, BPP, etc.) displaying correctly |
| **Contact** | ✅ Rendered | Two-column layout with office address/phone/email on left, contact form on right |
| **Footer** | ✅ Rendered | Black background with logo, Quick Links, and Contact Us information |

## 4) Visual Issues & Problems

### Critical Issues:
1. **Hero Background Color Failure**: As mentioned, the maroon/red brand color is missing from the hero section, replaced by gray/white.
2. **Hero Text Contrast**: White text on the light gray background fails accessibility standards (WCAG).

### Minor Issues:
3. **Project Card Images Missing**: The three project cards in the "Delivering Excellence Nationwide" section appear to have **blank/white image areas** where project photos should be displayed. Only the green "Completed" badges and text content are visible.
4. **Form Field Styling**: The contact form inputs (Name, Email, Phone, Subject, Message) appear to have very light borders that may be hard to distinguish from the white background.
5. **Equipment Section Spacing**: The equipment grid has significant whitespace at the bottom before the Compliance section begins, which may be intentional padding but looks slightly unbalanced.

### No Issues Found:
- **No overlapping elements** detected
- **No broken layouts** or misaligned grids
- **No missing navigation items**
- **Typography hierarchy** is consistent throughout
- **Card components** maintain uniform sizing and spacing

## 5) Professionalism & Cohesion Assessment

**Overall Design Quality: Good (7/10)**, with one major caveat:

**Strengths:**
- Clean, modern card-based layout with consistent border radius and shadows
- Excellent typographic hierarchy (clear H1, H2, H3 distinctions)
- Well-organized information architecture
- Consistent use of icons across Services and Equipment sections
- Professional footer with complete company information
- Responsive-looking grid systems (4-column for services, 3-column for projects)

**Cohesion Issues:**
- The **missing hero background color** breaks the visual identity immediately upon landing
- The color palette appears muted overall—the brand's signature red/maroon only appears in small accents (logo, buttons, badges) rather than creating strong visual impact

**Recommendation:** The primary fix needed is restoring the hero section's maroon/red background to establish brand presence immediately. Once corrected, the design will look professional, trustworthy, and cohesive for an engineering services firm.
